patterns.name: wrong-side RC
patterns.detection: RC target appears screen-left or matches LC/HH region instead of screen-right RC
patterns.qaAction: Compare against INSTRUMENT_CONTACT_POINTS RC and fixed-drum composite

patterns.name: RD wrong-side
patterns.detection: Ride strike occurs on screen-left/incorrect cymbal
patterns.qaAction: Compare to approved RD:R refresh pair and RD contact point

patterns.name: front-facing new character
patterns.detection: identity/camera no longer matches approved three-quarter-back baseline
patterns.qaAction: Identity/camera/stool visual comparison

patterns.name: edit_op null / fresh redraw
patterns.detection: generation metadata or visible result indicates fresh redraw rather than baseline edit
patterns.automaticAction: Do not auto-reject solely from edit_op=null. Treat it as a redraw-risk signal; reject only when visual continuity/locality QA confirms identity/camera/body/stool redraw.
patterns.qaAction: Run identity/camera/stool/body-scale comparison and changed-region locality check. If those pass and only intended limb motion changed, continue QA despite null metadata. If they fail, invoke character-retry-controller and change strategy.
patterns.latestEvidence: 2026-09-19 RTP-BRIDGE-001: exact formal PNGs materialized from Dropbox/Library, but image_gen still returned edit_op=null fresh redraw (SHA e34a1f46...) rather than direct parent edit.

patterns.name: drum hardware leak
patterns.detection: character layer contains drum/cymbal/pedal pixels
patterns.qaAction: Transparent-layer inspection + fixed-drum composite

patterns.name: stool shift
patterns.detection: stool/body registration moves between neutral/hit/rebound
patterns.qaAction: alpha bbox/centroid metrics + overlay

patterns.name: camera jump
patterns.detection: large whole-frame diff / body scale or camera orientation change
patterns.automaticAction: WARN then visual rejection if confirmed
patterns.qaAction: diff metrics + neutral/hit/rebound comparison

patterns.name: misleading Dropbox alias
patterns.detection: filename suggests approved SHA but bytes/SHA differ
patterns.automaticAction: NEVER_USE exact path; verify SHA before import
patterns.qaAction: Registry/path/SHA check
patterns.evidence: bd_sn misleading aliases documented in ledger

patterns.name: rejected candidate reused
patterns.detection: GitHub/Dropbox path or SHA matches REJECTED_ASSET_REGISTRY
patterns.qaAction: deny-list lookup

patterns.name: SN:R rebound jump
patterns.detection: deprecated sn_r_rebound causes visual discontinuity
patterns.automaticAction: Use approved runtime policy holding sn_r_hit
patterns.qaAction: Do not remap deprecated rebound without new QA

patterns.name: naturalWidth race in QA harness
patterns.detection: naturalWidth=0 immediately after src swap despite visible image shortly after
patterns.automaticAction: Wait for image dimensions/load before classifying failure
patterns.qaAction: Re-run after load wait

patterns.name: promoted pair missing prep neutral mapping
patterns.detection: runtimePhaseFrameMap contains hit/rebound for a newly promoted action but no prep frame; character prototype initialization reports 'prototype phase frame missing for <action>.prep'
patterns.automaticAction: Do not regenerate image bytes. Add prep:'neutral' to the action mapping and repair promotion workflow so future pairs receive prep automatically.
patterns.qaAction: Run public runtime QA again and require initError empty plus hit/rebound frame match on PC/Xperia.
patterns.evidence: M54 BD+HT:RF/L runtime QA run 35420229339 exposed exact initError after QA harness diagnostics were fixed.

patterns.name: head direction changed during local edit
patterns.problem: Head direction or crown orientation changes even though the requested edit is local.
patterns.cause: The edit is interpreted as a whole-character redraw or reference pose import.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not redraw/repose the head or import head orientation from the reference image.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Return to the baseline image and apply a tightly scoped local patch while preserving head silhouette/orientation.
patterns.detection: Head direction/crown orientation differs from baseline outside the allowed edit.
patterns.automaticAction: REJECT candidate and retry from baseline with a local patch.
patterns.qaAction: Baseline-to-candidate overlay plus outside-edit-region diff check.

patterns.name: cowlick tip ends in air
patterns.problem: One or both cowlick strand tips terminate in open space instead of landing on the hair.
patterns.cause: Cowlick geometry was freely reinterpreted rather than copied from the locked reference.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not accept floating strand tips or shorten the reference geometry arbitrarily.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Rebuild only the cowlick patch from the locked geometry and require both tips to land on the hair.
patterns.detection: Cowlick endpoint does not reconnect to visible hair.
patterns.qaAction: Inspect both strand endpoints against the locked cowlick reference.

patterns.name: cowlick collapsed to V shape
patterns.problem: Two-strand cowlick is simplified into a V.
patterns.cause: Reference geometry was summarized instead of followed.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not replace the two ヘ-like strands with a V.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Restore the two distinct locked strand shapes with a small triangular negative space.
patterns.detection: Cowlick silhouette reads as a single V.
patterns.qaAction: Compare geometry directly to COWLICK_REFERENCE_STATE.

patterns.name: cowlick collapsed to U shape
patterns.problem: Cowlick is rounded into a U-like loop.
patterns.cause: Reference geometry was smoothed or stylized.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not round the locked angular two-strand shape into a U.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Restore the two angular strand paths from the reference.
patterns.detection: Cowlick silhouette reads as U/rounded loop.
patterns.qaAction: Direct geometry comparison to locked cowlick reference.

patterns.name: cowlick interpreted as two plain lines
patterns.problem: Cowlick becomes two disconnected/simple strokes without the locked shape and triangular gap.
patterns.cause: Only strand count was preserved while geometry was discarded.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not satisfy the requirement with merely two arbitrary lines.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Use the locked two-strand ヘ / mirrored-ヘ geometry and preserve the triangular negative space.
patterns.detection: Two lines exist but the required strand silhouettes/landing points are absent.
patterns.qaAction: Check roots, bends, triangular gap, and landing points.

patterns.name: cowlick changed to one strand splitting in two
patterns.problem: The required two-strand cowlick is redrawn as one root/strand that forks.
patterns.cause: The two close roots were merged during simplification.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not merge the two strands into one bifurcated stroke.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Keep two distinct strands with close roots and independent hair landing points.
patterns.detection: Single parent stroke visibly branches into two.
patterns.qaAction: Inspect root topology against locked reference.

patterns.name: reference image freely interpreted
patterns.problem: Unrequested face/body/camera/head/composition traits are imported from a local reference.
patterns.cause: Reference scope was treated as vague inspiration instead of property-specific authority.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not use a reference without explicitly defining included and excluded properties.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Declare reference scope first, then transfer only the permitted local geometry/style property.
patterns.detection: Candidate contains unrelated traits traceable to the reference.
patterns.qaAction: Compare baseline, reference scope declaration, and candidate.

patterns.name: single thick digital stroke cleanup
patterns.problem: Apparent thick/dark linework is replaced by one smooth thick digital stroke.
patterns.cause: Line thickness was produced by brush-size change instead of repeated fine strokes.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not switch to a thicker digital brush to imitate baseline density.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Use the same fine-width stroke and retrace 3-4 or more slightly offset passes as needed.
patterns.detection: Smooth uniform thick contour replaces visible multi-stroke construction.
patterns.qaAction: Baseline-to-variant line-construction comparison.

patterns.name: multi-stroke linework simplified to single line
patterns.problem: Existing rough repeated fine strokes are cleaned into a single line.
patterns.cause: Cleanup optimization removes deliberate hand-drawn retracing.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not simplify multi-line contours merely for neatness.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Preserve or rebuild repeated fine-stroke density from the baseline.
patterns.detection: Baseline has multiple nearby strokes while candidate has one polished contour.
patterns.qaAction: Check repeated-stroke presence and line density against baseline.

patterns.name: vector-like over-cleanup
patterns.problem: Hand-drawn wobble/unevenness is removed and contours become vector-like.
patterns.cause: Whole-image cleanup or smoothing was applied beyond the requested local edit.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not globally smooth, vectorize, or polish the character.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Restore baseline roughness and limit edits to the allowed patch.
patterns.detection: Uniform smooth contours and reduced rough retracing compared with baseline.
patterns.qaAction: Style comparison directly against baseline.

patterns.name: local correction became full-character redraw
patterns.problem: A local requested correction changes the whole character/frame.
patterns.cause: The tool/strategy regenerated the complete image rather than patching the target region.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not accept or continue from a whole-frame redraw for a local correction.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Crop/edit/composite the smallest viable patch and verify pixels outside the allowed region remain unchanged.
patterns.detection: Large changed-region bbox or nonzero changes outside the allowed local region.
patterns.automaticAction: REJECT candidate; return to original baseline bytes.
patterns.qaAction: Outside-allowed-region pixel diff; target zero changed pixels when technically possible.

patterns.name: image edit request rendered as documentation sheet
patterns.problem: The candidate became a before/after QA/documentation sheet rather than a transparent character-only edit.
patterns.cause: The generation request was interpreted as a presentation/diagram instead of an edit of the claimed formal PNG.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not use a descriptive presentation/QA-sheet prompt or accept any candidate containing labels, panels, drum drawings, or documentation text.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Retry only with the exact formal source image explicitly scoped as the edit target; require character-only transparent output and preserve all non-motion regions.
patterns.detection: Candidate contains text/panels/comparison layout and is not a 1448x1086 character layer.
patterns.qaAction: Require transparent character-only layer, source-target identity preservation, and fixed-drum composite QA.

patterns.name: Dropbox alias looked canonical but bytes did not match GitHub formal SHA256
patterns.problem: Dropbox files named sn_hit_l.png / sn_rebound_l.png were initially treated as likely canonical bridges, but materialized bytes did not match the formal GitHub SHA256.
patterns.cause: Filename/path similarity was used before exact byte verification. Dropbox content_hash is not SHA256 and cannot prove GitHub byte identity.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not treat a Dropbox filename, path, size alone, preview, or Dropbox content_hash as formal identity proof. In particular, never assume plain aliases such as sn_hit_l.png or sn_rebound_l.png are current formal bytes.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Use GitHub formal path+SHA256 as authority. Materialize Dropbox raw bytes and compute SHA256. When the obvious alias mismatches, use GitHub blob size/SHA metadata plus Dropbox inventory to locate alternate candidates, then SHA256-verify.
patterns.detection: Computed SHA256 of materialized Dropbox object differs from formal GitHub SHA256.
patterns.automaticAction: REJECT the bridge alias for formal-source use; record it as stale/misleading and continue searching.
patterns.qaAction: Require exact SHA256 equality before renderer-parent use.
patterns.evidence: 2026-09-19 RTP-BRIDGE: plain sn_hit_l.png and sn_rebound_l.png mismatched formal SHA; contactfix aliases matched exact formal SHA.

patterns.name: Files image_file read on Dropbox mount did not expose native image pixels
patterns.problem: files.read(mode=image_file) on Dropbox-mounted PNG returned 'Native image pixels were unavailable', so it cannot be relied on as a renderer-parent bridge.
patterns.cause: Dropbox external file provider exposes metadata/raw materialization but not native pixels through files.read image_file in this environment.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not repeatedly retry files.read(mode=image_file) on Dropbox-mounted PNGs expecting it to make the image editable.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Use files.list on /Dropbox to obtain the external file_id, then files.materialize(raw_file) to /mnt/data, SHA256-verify, and re-expose the exact file as a current-conversation attachment if renderer input is required.
patterns.detection: files.read image_file warning includes 'Native image pixels were unavailable'.
patterns.automaticAction: Switch immediately to raw materialization bridge.
patterns.qaAction: After materialization compute SHA256 and compare to GitHub formal authority.
patterns.evidence: 2026-09-19 RTP-BRIDGE-001 exact neutral/hit/rebound Dropbox image_file reads returned native-pixels-unavailable warnings.

patterns.name: renderer ignored intended exact-source edit target and generated project-status dashboard
patterns.problem: After exact formal neutral/hit/rebound/drum images were materialized, SHA-verified and re-exposed in the current conversation, the image renderer still produced an unrelated project-status dashboard instead of editing the neutral character layer.
patterns.cause: Current image renderer invocation did not bind the intended exact source image as an edit parent; conversation context was interpreted as a general project-status image-generation request.
patterns.prohibitedStrategy: Do not retry generic image_gen in this session for SN:L candidate rendering unless the tool can explicitly bind the exact source image as the edit target and preserve character-layer semantics.
patterns.nextPermittedStrategy: Keep numeric refinement and source bridge evidence; use a renderer/environment with explicit edit-target binding, or a proven deterministic local-edit tool after geometry is validated. Continue non-image QA/tooling in the meantime.
patterns.detection: Generated image is not a 1448x1086 transparent character-only layer derived from the exact neutral source, or edit metadata indicates a fresh generation rather than target-bound edit.
patterns.automaticAction: REJECT output; do not save to Dropbox staging, do not register, do not use as parent.
patterns.qaAction: Require explicit target-bound edit evidence plus transparent character-only 1448x1086 output before candidate QA.
patterns.evidence: 2026-09-19 current session renderer retry after exact-source bridge and neutral-shoulder numeric refinement produced unrelated status-dashboard image instead of SN:L character edit.

adaptiveRetry.onRepeat: Invoke tools/character-retry-controller.mjs and force a different strategy.
adaptiveRetry.policy: FAIL is not a terminal boolean. Every failure must produce a next strategy or a specific external blocker.

sharedLearningPolicy.purpose: Make image-generation failures and recoveries reusable across parallel terminals/sessions.
rules: Refresh GitHub main before every image-generation batch and before every registry write.
When a new reusable failure mode is observed, add or update a pattern with detection, severity, automaticAction, qaAction and evidence.
When exact candidate bytes/path must never be reused, also register them in REJECTED_ASSET_REGISTRY.json.
When a failure is action-specific rather than reusable, record it in that action transaction instead of polluting the global registry.
When a successful workaround resolves a recurring failure, append the proven recovery strategy to the relevant pattern evidence/guidance.
Parallel terminals must never delete or rewrite another terminal's failure history; reconcile by appending/superseding.
